# MemMap

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Maps a memory object into the caller's address space.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0B` SVC_MANAGEMEMORY | `MNGMEM_MAP (0)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
void * MemMap(Handle mem_handle, VirtAddr hint_va, MemProt prot);
```

**Registers:** `(mem, hint | prot) -> r0 address or error`

A handle can back one mapping at a time; duplicate it to map the object twice.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mem_handle` | in | Memory object handle with PERM_MAP, plus PERM_WRITE to map writable and PERM_EXEC to map executable. |
| `hint_va` | in | Page-aligned address to map at, or 0 to let the kernel choose. |
| `prot` | in | PROT_READ / PROT_WRITE / PROT_EXEC, but never writable and executable. |

## Returns

The mapped address, or an error encoded as a pointer; check with PtrIsErr().

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `mem_handle` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `mem_handle` is not a memory object. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `mem_handle` lacks PERM_MAP, or the PERM_WRITE / PERM_EXEC `prot` asks for, or PROT_EXEC on uncached memory. |
| [`ERR_BUSY`](../errors.md#err_busy) | This handle is already mapped. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `hint_va` is unusable, or `prot` is both writable and executable. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | No address space or page tables left. |
